title: staging drain_one race: deferred tx not BEGIN IMMEDIATE
description:
## What / Why
drain_one() in crates/transit/src/staging.rs opens a transaction with pool.begin() (SQLite DEFERRED), not BEGIN IMMEDIATE. With multiple concurrent drain workers, two workers can both SELECT the same unclaimed row before either UPDATE sets claimed_at, causing the same article to be processed twice through the IPFS pipeline and group-log append.

## Trigger → Bad Behavior
Two drain tasks running concurrently on a staging store with ≥1 unclaimed row → both read the same row → both write the same article to IPFS and append the same message-id to the group log, producing a duplicate log entry.

## Fix
Change pool.begin() in drain_one to an explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE: sqlx::query('BEGIN IMMEDIATE').execute(&mut *tx) before the SELECT, or use sqlx's acquire + raw IMMEDIATE query. This serializes the claim step.
